description.en:
Tells whether a character is in the first 5 places of the player's team order.
It is the same check as CMND_BTL_IS_MATCH_MEMBER, limited to 5 places instead of 16. The game's player lists treat those first 5 places as a group of their own, which matches the size of a 5-a-side challenge line-up.
It is never called by the shipped scripts.
Player parameter ID to look for, e.g. "para_cp0008".

true if the character is in the first 5 places, false otherwise.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Requiring the protagonist in the main five (not found in script_clean/; invented)
